text:
Predicates:
Istanbul(x) ::: x is a vehicle registration plate from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(x, y) ::: x begins with the number y.
Premises:
∀x (Istanbul(x) → BeginsWith(x, 34)) ::: All vehicle registration plates in Istanbul begin with the number 34.
∀x (¬BeginsWith(x, 34) → ¬Istanbul(x)) ::: Plates that do not begin with the number 34 are not from Istanbul.
Istanbul(joesPlate) ::: Joe's vehicle registration plate is from Istanbul.
BeginsWith(tomsPlate, 35) ::: Tom's license plate begins with the number 35.
BeginsWith(x, 35) → ¬BeginsWith(x, 34) ::: If a license plate begins with the number 35, then it does not begin with the number 34.
Conclusion:
¬Istanbul(tomsPlate) ::: Tom's license plate is from Istanbul.
